intro.TrustedMarkup:
Editor support for the generators std/rpc exports.

No program links this module, so a program that uses std/rpc pays nothing for it. A tool finds it beside std/rpc by its name. The generators of std/rpc that bake a symbolMap export into what they write, one name per line.

The generators of std/rpc that mount a server surface, one name per line: a root that calls one is a root vyrn dev serves.
